rates.quote: (a) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the recipient is a company which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
(b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends, in all other cases.

2. However, such interest may be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, and according to the laws of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2. However, such royalties may be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, and according to the laws of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

notes: Treaty concluded with the SFR Yugoslavia (English only); instruments of ratification exchanged in 1983, entry into force 26 May 1983, WHT effect from 1 Jan 1984 (valid_from shows the treaty's original application date). Succession: Belgium and Kosovo confirmed by exchange of notes (19 and 20 Nov 2009, 16 and 18 Dec 2009) that the Belgium-SFRY agreements remain in force between Belgium and the Republic of Kosovo, reportedly published in the Moniteur belge of 14 May 2010 - the Moniteur text itself was not reached (secondary-host copy returned 404; the Belgian Chamber site rejected the request and was not retried); Belgium's MLI position lists the treaty as "Yougoslavie - Kosovo"; ATK lists it in force from 23.02.2010, applicable 13.04.2012. Protocol 1: "dividends" include income from invested capital received by members of Belgian companies other than companies with share capital. A new Belgium-Kosovo convention was reportedly signed on 16 April 2026 (not in force at 2026-10-07; not verified). ATK summary table 10/15%, 15%, 10% - consistent. Kosovo is not an MLI party.
